headline: Buy 4 Low-Beta Defensive Stocks as Fed Keeps Interest Rate Unchanged
summary: SWX, ATO, COCO and WLY stand out as low-beta defensive picks as the Fed holds rates steady amid market volatility, inflation worries and a tech selloff.
